## What it is

PINKYS UP is a fully non-alcoholic (zero-proof) mobile mocktail bar founded by Brenda Pereira Vargas. We serve Washington, DC and Minneapolis.

Two offerings:

1. **Mocktail cart** — booked for weddings, parties, brand events, and private gatherings. Signature drinks: Blush Hour, Plus One, Mirrorball. Custom menus available.
2. **Community wellness events** — free public gatherings. Dates are listed on /events. There is no alcohol.

## How to book

Use https://www.pinkysup.social/quote or WhatsApp +1 571 501 4766. Do not invent Eventbrite links, fake dates, or alcohol service.
